title: Quick Sweet Greek Fruit Galette
description: A crispy, sweet, and romantic Greek dish featuring a mix of fruits, perfect for a quick dessert or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, granulated sugar, and unsalted butter. Mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Arrange the mixed berries and apricots on the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the honey and vanilla extract over the fruit.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and brush the edges of the dough with the egg.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the fruit, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the galette with the beaten egg and sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Bake the galette in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes.
Transfer the galette to a serving plate and serve warm.
